name: Sony DualShock 4 / DualSense
description: Adapted from OpenRGB's SonyGamepadController: the light bar of the Sony DualShock 4 (054C:05C4, 054C:09CC) and of its USB wireless adapter (054C:0BA0), and the light bar and five player LEDs of the DualSense (054C:0CE6) and DualSense Edge (054C:0DF2), over USB only. Rumble, haptics, adaptive triggers, volume, audio routing and the microphone LED are never touched. Tested on hardware: DualSense (054C:0CE6), light bar; the DualShock 4 ids and the DualSense Edge are untested. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/sony-gamepad.md.
